**RENEWAL — compliant (rule not applicable to this term structure).**

- **Investigation:** Searched for "renew", "automatically renew", "term of this Agreement", and the regex `extend|extension|expiration|successive|anniversary|price increase`, plus fee-uplift queries. No renewal, extension, or price-escalation mechanic exists anywhere. The only "extension" hits concern Obligor payment extensions on Receivables (Section 3.x) and Upgrade Offers — unrelated to contract term renewal.
- **Article VIII read in full:** Sections 8.1–8.2 are Optional Acquisition / Optional Redemption of Notes; Section 8.3 is a single termination trigger (last Receivable paid in full or Issuer terminated under the Trust Agreement). There is no fixed term that could roll over.
- **Direction check:** Nothing here binds us to an auto-renewal, notice window, or uplift, so there is no adverse term to flag; the conditional preferred elements are satisfied vacuously, and Section 10.1(a) treats amendment as an act of "the parties" (mutual), consistent with the preferred position.
- **No redline proposed**, per the rule that compliant findings are not redlined.
